stations.name: Long fast straight (1.3 km)
stations.note: Check: lift off the throttle at 70-100 mph ([ ] changes speed): no spin | small tap corrections at speed: no wobble or oscillation | roads look about 2 m wider

stations.name: Gentle bend (R~230 m, 44 deg)
stations.note: Check: lift off the throttle in the bend with small corrections: car must not spin | steering stays smooth through the sweeper | roads look about 2 m wider

stations.name: Tight corner (~86 deg, two-stage)
stations.note: Check: lift mid-corner: tail steps out clearly AND is catchable | deliberate full-lock slide is controllable | no spin on small corrections

stations.name: Edge berm (150 m to the map edge)
stations.note: Check: crash into the wall at speed: visible low wall stops you like a building | no teleport | a timed run keeps running | near an edge ramp: car goes over and falls (R restarts)

stations.name: Busiest town view (34 buildings, 2.2 km of road within 300 m)
stations.note: Check (use 0-20 mph): read the ?debug HUD in the busiest spot: render ms, terrain tex ms, frame ms, draw calls | render must stay under 6.0 ms

stations.name: Area-crossing run (1.1 km)
stations.note: Check: drive flat out and read the ?debug HUD while crossing the terrain chunk boundaries: render ms, terrain tex ms, frame ms, draw calls | render must stay under 6.0 ms
